key_insight: InfiniteWeb automatically synthesizes large, multi‑page, functional web environments so GUI agents can be trained at scale — bridging the gap between single-page LLM outputs and realistic, interlinked websites.
problem_solved: Addresses the shortage of realistic, interactive web environments for training and evaluating GUI agents, where manually creating many coherent multi‑page sites is costly and single‑page generation by LLMs is insufficient.
method: Pipeline that composes websites from modular page templates and site‑level plans generated by LLMs to ensure coherent multi‑page structure.
Automatic synthesis of interactive components, navigation logic and stateful UX (forms, links, modals) plus simulated user flows to create functional behavior.
Automated validation and scaling (emulation/crawling and behavioral tests) to filter, repair and expand environments for large dataset creation.
impact: Enables researchers and engineers to train more robust, generalizable GUI agents without costly manual environment engineering, accelerating progress on web automation, assistive interfaces, and downstream evaluation benchmarks.

paper_title: InfiniteWeb: Scalable Web Environment Synthesis for GUI Agent Training
